d:
An alliance is being formed between Owaisi’s party and Chandrashekhar’s party in UP. This will be announced on November 12; the AIMIM and the Azad Samaj Party are eyeing Muslim and Dalit votes. The question is, will the emergence of this 'third front' add to the headaches of the INDIA alliance, led by Akhilesh Yadav and Rahul Gandhi?
